## About
SoMyung provides AI-powered Korean Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny / 사주팔자)
analysis for understanding children's innate temperament and learning styles.
Created by a certified professional and parent of three.

Supported languages: ko, en, ja, zh, vi, id, es, pt, fr, th
Language-specific pages: /en, /ja, /zh, /vi, /id, /es, /pt, /fr, /th
About page: /about (also /en/about, /ja/about, etc.)
Price: Free preview + Premium report $4.99
